links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT responses to gender-affirmation surgery questions versus physician responses
links.effect: ChatGPT responses were significantly more complex across five readability metrics than physician responses, though they scored higher on DISCERN and PEMAT. The authors note the high reading level raises implementation concerns.
links.quote: We found that ChatGPT's responses were significantly more complex across five readability metrics but had significantly higher DISCERN and PEMAT scores compared to physician responses, indicating superior reliability, quality, and understandability.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's responses to patient FAQs regarding gender-affirmation surgery compared to physician responses, focusing on readability and quality, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
